name: FREN 3217
title: Business French
description: Introduction to the vocabulary, communication skills, and cultural literacy required for work in a French-speaking environment. Topics may include French and international business, the French and European economy, industries, NGOs, diplomacy, and other international institutions. Composition of  a curriculum vitae and business letters in formal and informal registers of French. Taught in French.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: FREN 1104, three years of high school French, or equivalent proficiency level.
